title: Five stars without hesitation!
text:

title: Great Tour of Seville with an Excellent Guide
text:
We had a wonderful experience on our short visit to Seville, thanks to this well-organized tour. Our guide, Filippo, was fantastic – knowledgeable, friendly, and very helpful. He shared fascinating information about the city’s history, especially about the Real Alcázar and the Cathedral.

Due to limited time, we chose not to enter the Cathedral, but Filippo still gave us a great overview and walked us around the city, making the most of our stop. We visited the Real Alcázar, which was stunning, and appreciated the insight Filippo provided throughout.

Highly recommended! Just a note to future
author: Jawaher_A
